information: It will be noisy. Please bring earmuffs/plugs if you are easily distracted. AU$10 (Competitors). Max 100 competitors. Online payment via PayPal required. Friends and family may need to purchase daily tickets from arnoldlassic.com.au to enter the Kids Expo.
